## Run A

1. **Set routing.** The arguments hold two PR tokens, so I read `reference/batch.md` before steps 1-7.

2. **Admission, before any other effect.** I run `git remote get-url origin`, which prints `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Both bare numbers normalize to `acme/widgets#112` and `acme/widgets#101`.
   - There is no positional issue reference and no duplicate.
   - There is no foreign-repository URL.
   - The harness is pi.
   - Two PRs fit within `parallel.maxTasks` 4.

   This is a typed set, so I print no `discovered, smallest first:` line.

3. **Parent run folder.** I mint the parent `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout through `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. This happens before any roster or record exists.

4. **Per-PR gathers, in typed order, with each token unchanged:**
   - `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`
   - `gh pr view 101` with the same `--json` and `--jq`.

   Both return the supplied rows.

5. **Viewer reads, once each for the typed set:**
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.

6. **Ticket display reads.**
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`.
   - `git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet.md`, `git show origin/main:gauntlet.md` and `git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet.md` are read in search order. No tracker override is present, so Linear stays allowed, but neither PR needs it.
   - **#112:** the first closing reference is `acme/widgets#22`, which matches origin, so it shows as `#22`.
   - **#101:** it has no closing reference. The branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, so it shows as `#45`.
   - **Why each PR is listed:** #112 is by pat with no pending request, so it shows `by pat`. #101's author matches `alex`, so it shows `yours`.

7. **List before provisioning.** The list goes in the reply that carries the first provisioning command. Gauntlet adds no marker and does not wait.

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - route all settings reads through one shared resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---
Paired call: `git fetch origin`

**Next step:** serial provisioning (`reference/batch.md` `## Provision serially`), one worktree at a time in roster order. The provisioning list check is already satisfied, so I do not reprint the list.

## Run B:
```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet.md
```

**How the results resolve:**
- **Single path.** One typed PR, and Section A is already in context, so there is no read for it.
- **Base repository.** It comes from the view's `url`, which is `acme/gadgets`. I do not run `git remote get-url origin`.
- **Ticket.** The closing reference `acme/gadgets#45` matches that base repository, so it shows as `#45`.
- **Why it is listed.** It is by robin, with a pending User request for `alex`.
- **Overrides.** The overrides reads find no file.
- **Linear.** There are no Linear addresses in the title or body.

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, [#45](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/issues/45) - add a CSV export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

**After that call:**
1. I keep its result in context.
2. I mint the run folder and initialize its continuation record (`post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`).
3. I run `plan_tracker` `init` with `gather, provision, verify`. There is no `--rebase`, so there is no `sync` stage.

**The rest of Gather** reuses the saved preamble and the first run list. It resumes at the GraphQL call:
- `gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=gadgets -F n=97`
- `gh repo view acme/gadgets --json nameWithOwner`
- `gh pr diff 97 -R acme/gadgets`
- `gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`
- `gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
- `gh api repos/acme/gadgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
- `git worktree list --porcelain`. No worktree exists for #97.

**What I skip:**
- No placeholder comment appears, so I run no `gh run view`.
- No reviewer workflow is known, so I run no reviewer `gh run list`.

**Digest settles:**
- `issue_ref` is `#45`.
- `viewer.role` is `requested reviewer`.
- `prior_review` is `null`.

I close `gather` in the tracker.

**Next step:** step 2, Provision + configure (`reference/assessment.md`).
